title: 第六十八章 九天泄水洪流涌 泽国汪洋又逢殃第六十七章 地脉崩摇千山裂 沉垣陷土劫无穷
content_zh:
诗曰：
地脉初宁山未整，倾盆骤雨落苍穹。
百川暴涨横流处，万里桑田尽水中。
地动山摇之劫方才平息，千山残损，大地裂痕纵横，幸存百姓尚在瓦砾之间收拾残生，惊魂未定。六道圣尊依旧敛却神通，布衣行脚，踏着满目断石碎土继续西行。
连日来天地气机紊乱至极，前番旱燥郁积、风火交加、地脉震荡，乾坤阴阳久失调和。待到地劫暂歇，郁结水气猛然生发，天际云团层层汇聚，遮断烈日，不过半日光景，淅淅沥沥的雨点便洒落下来。
何日抬首望空，雨丝拂面，蹙眉吟道：
“久旱逢霖本是祥，谁云雨势太张狂。
山崩地裂民方定，又恐洪波漫野荒。
此地山峦残破，河道淤塞，田畴尽是坑洼裂土。寻常细雨尚可润万物，若是暴雨倾盆，百川必然溃决，洪灾一至，更是灭顶之祸。”
白洁俯身看向脚下泥地，雨水越落越急，地面转眼泥泞不堪，轻声叹道：
“乾坤失序祸相连，六劫才休水又缠。
旱极生霖霖转暴，一朝平地化沧渊。
人心、兵戈、旱、风、火、地六重劫难皆已历过，如今第七难洪水大劫接踵而至。水火相济本是天道常理，可积旱骤雨，势难调和，平地顷刻便会沦为泽国。”
何月闭目感察云水动向，神色愈发凝重：“云气奔涌，雨柱连天，此番绝非寻常霖雨。上游群山崩颓，河床被山石淤泥堵塞，水流无处宣泄，必然漫溢四野。山摇之后再遇洪水，百姓连立身之地都难寻了。”
公孙离望着远处起伏的山峦，雨幕茫茫，怅然咏道：
“历尽千灾骨已疲，苍生何日得安栖。
山洪一旦平川漫，万户流离逐浪移。
此前诸般灾厄，尚可寻高地、躲深窖、避残屋。洪水滔滔，水势漫延无孔不入，低处尽被吞没，逃生之路最为狭窄。”
花月步道：“我等依旧严守规矩，不施行云布雨、分水挡洪之术。只凭凡人身形，奔走呼号，引民登高，救溺扶危。以血肉之躯，共渡这滔天水厄，再磨一层道心。”
黄鼬妖缩在衣襟之间，听着雨声渐密，忧心忡忡：“雨越下越大啦，地上到处都是裂缝坑洼，水积起来跑都跑不快，百姓可往高处去啊！”

何年目光扫过沿途村落与河道，沉声道：“雨势已成，洪峰将至。诸位即刻分头行动，沿路传告乡民，舍弃低处屋舍，尽数迁往附近高山、丘岗等高处避险。能多劝一人，便多留一条生机。动身！”
众人不再迟疑，踏着泥泞冒雨疾行。
转瞬之间，大雨由淅沥化作倾盆！
但见：
黑风卷雨锁遥岑，万道银线落天深。
滂沱不住连三日，百川奔涌起洪音。
山涧激流吞乱石，长河巨浪溃堤林。
平畴万顷成湖海，村舍千门没水沉。
老弱呼号随浪走，壮丁挣扎觅高岑。
茫茫泽国无边际，满目凄凉泪湿襟。
暴雨连宵不息，上游群山之间，无数山泉、涧水汇作洪流。崩塌的山体堵塞河道，河水节节暴涨，坚固河堤接连被巨浪冲垮。浑浊的洪水如猛兽出笼，顺着地势奔腾而下，一路吞噬良田、村落、道路。
content_en:
The poem says:
At the beginning of the earth's veins, the Ningshan Mountains were not straightened out, and heavy rain fell from the sky.
Where hundreds of rivers surge across their currents, thousands of miles of mulberry fields are drained of water.
The catastrophe of earthquakes and mountains has just subsided. Thousands of mountains were damaged and the earth was cracked. The surviving people were still picking up the pieces among the rubble, still in shock. The Holy Lord of Six Paths still collected his magical power, walked in civilian clothes, and continued to walk westward on broken stones and dirt everywhere.
In the past few days, the qi of heaven and earth has been extremely chaotic. In the past, drought and dryness were accumulated, wind and fire were intertwined, the earth's veins were oscillating, and the yin and yang of the universe were out of balance for a long time. When the earth's calamity paused, the stagnation of water vapor suddenly emerged, and clouds gathered in the sky, blocking the scorching sun. Within half a day, the pattering raindrops began to fall.
He raised his head and looked up at the sky, the rain was blowing on his face, he frowned and said:
"It is auspicious to encounter rain after a long drought, but the rain is too arrogant.
Landslides and landslides will tear people apart, and floods will flood the wilderness.
The mountains here are broken, the rivers are blocked, and the fields are full of potholes and cracked soil. Ordinary drizzle can still moisturize everything, but if it rains heavily, hundreds of rivers will inevitably burst, and floods will be a disaster. "
Bai Jie leaned over and looked at the muddy ground under her feet. The rain was falling faster and faster, and the ground was suddenly muddy. She sighed softly:
“The universe is out of order and disasters are connected, and the six tribulations only stop and the water is entangled again.
Extreme drought produces rain and then turns into violent storms, and once the flat land turns into abyss.
The six catastrophes of human heart, war, drought, wind, fire, and earth have all been experienced, and now the seventh catastrophe, the flood, is coming one after another. The harmony of water and fire is a common law of nature, but drought and sudden rains can make it difficult to reconcile the situation, and the flat land will turn into a marshy country in an instant. "
He Yue closed her eyes to observe the movement of the clouds and water, and her expression became more solemn: "The clouds are rushing, and the rain is falling all over the sky. This is definitely not an ordinary rain. The mountains in the upper reaches have collapsed, and the river bed is blocked by rocks and silt. The water has nowhere to vent, and it will inevitably overflow the countryside. If there is a flood after the mountains shake, it will be difficult for the people to find a place to stay."
Gongsun Li looked at the undulating mountains in the distance, covered with rain, and chanted sadly:
“My bones are tired after experiencing thousands of disasters, how will the common people find a safe place to live?
Once the mountain floods flood the plains, thousands of households will be displaced.
In all the previous disasters, one could still seek high ground, hide in deep cellars, and avoid dilapidated houses. The floods were surging and the water spread all over the place, swallowing up all the low places and making the escape route the narrowest. "
Huayue Trail: "We still strictly abide by the rules and do not use the techniques of clouds to spread rain or divert water to block floods. We only rely on our mortal bodies to run and shout, lead people to the heights, and save people from drowning. We will use our flesh and blood to tide over this monstrous water together and sharpen our Taoist heart."
The yellow weasel demon huddled between his clothes, listening to the sound of rain getting thicker, and he was worried: "The rain is getting heavier and heavier. There are cracks and potholes everywhere on the ground. When the water accumulates, you can't run fast. People should go to higher ground!"
He Nian glanced at the villages and rivers along the way, and said in a deep voice: "The rain has begun, and the peak of the flood is approaching. You all immediately split up and told the villagers along the road to abandon the low-lying houses and move to nearby mountains, hills and other high places for safety. If you can persuade one more person, you will have one more chance of survival. Let's go!"
Everyone no longer hesitated and walked quickly through the mud and rain.
In the blink of an eye, the heavy rain turned from pattering to pouring!
But see:
The dark wind and rain lock the remote Cen, and thousands of silver threads fall deep into the sky.
The torrential waves continued for three days, and hundreds of rivers surged with torrential sounds.
The rapids in the mountain stream swallowed up rocks, and the huge waves in the long river broke the embankments and forests.
The vast expanse of land has turned into lakes and seas, and thousands of cottages have been sunk by the water.
The old and the weak follow the waves with their cries, while the strong men struggle to find Gao Cen.
The boundless country is full of desolation and tears.
The heavy rain continued all night long, and among the mountains upstream, countless mountain springs and streams formed torrents. Collapsed mountains blocked the river channel, the river water surged, and the solid river embankments were washed away by huge waves one after another. The turbid floods surged down the terrain like ferocious beasts, devouring fertile fields, villages, and roads along the way.
